description: Scored rubric for synthesis quality, focused on the insight layer (evidence weighting, contradiction surfacing, decision-drivers). Each dimension is scored 0-2 by a judge (human or LLM) reading a finished report against its findings files. Total 20. A report scoring < 14 should be regenerated.
how_to_run: evals/eval_synthesis.sh re-synthesizes each retained fixture with the current synthesizer prompt via `pi -p`, then runs scripts/lint_report.py on the output. The linter's hard checks gate the exit code; the soft dimensions below are scored by a judge for human review. See that script's header.

scoring.0: Major findings from one or more OK source files are absent from the report
scoring.1: Most findings represented; some notable omissions
scoring.2: Every OK findings file is meaningfully represented; nothing load-bearing dropped

scoring.0: Uncited factual claims, or citations that don't match the source
scoring.1: Mostly cited; a few gaps or format violations
scoring.2: Every factual claim carries [N]; same URL = same number; strict [N] [Title](url) format

scoring.0: No Key Tensions section, or it just re-lists features with no decision implication
scoring.1: Section present; some bullets state trade-offs, others are restated facts
scoring.2: Section present; every bullet names a real trade-off/driver AND its second-order implication for a decision

scoring.0: Conflicting sources silently collapsed to one claim; vendor claims stated as fact
scoring.1: Some disagreement surfaced; some uncorroborated vendor claims still stated flatly
scoring.2: Consensus & Contradictions section present; disagreements shown with both sides; uncorroborated vendor claims labeled 'vendor-reported, not independently verified'

scoring.0: A community/blog claim overrides an official source on a factual point, with no confidence signal
scoring.1: Weighting mostly sensible; confidence rarely made explicit
scoring.2: Higher-authority sources win factual conflicts; confidence levels made visible where it matters; recency breaks ties

scoring.0: WEAK/MISSING sources papered over or ignored
scoring.1: Some gaps noted; not all WEAK/MISSING sources accounted for
scoring.2: Every WEAK/MISSING source appears in Gaps & Limitations with a follow-up suggestion

scoring.1: Recommendations present but thin or not tied to the findings
scoring.2: 3-5 concrete recommendations, each grounded in cited findings and matching query intent
Coherent narrative organized by topic, bridging sentences, arc matches the query intent

scoring.0: Contains claims not traceable to any findings file
scoring.1: One or two soft extrapolations, labeled
scoring.2: Every claim traces to a findings file; derived numbers carry a source or ⚠️ label

scoring.0: Padded, redundant, or over the 8,000-word ceiling
scoring.1: Slightly long or repetitive in places
scoring.2: 2,500-6,000 words, no redundancy, every section earns its place

regression_fixtures.why: Comparison intent with pricing + web + docs; should exercise Key Tensions and Consensus & Contradictions
expects: Key Tensions & Decision Drivers section present
cost/perf trade-off stated as a decision driver, not a feature list

regression_fixtures.why: Architecture + code-examples; multiple sources likely to overlap and occasionally disagree
expects: consensus vs contradiction distinction where sources overlap

regression_fixtures.why: Heavy vendor-claim surface (launch benchmarks) - should be labeled 'vendor-reported'
expects: vendor benchmark claims labeled as vendor-reported

gate_policy: hard dimensions are graded mechanically by scripts/lint_report.py and fail the release gate. soft dimensions are scored by a judge and stay ADVISORY until that judge is calibrated against human labels per the enterprise eval methodology. The 14/20 threshold is a review trigger, not an automated gate.
